name: Charades: Daily Life Indoor Activity Video Dataset
description: Charades is a dataset of 9,848 untrimmed daily-life indoor videos recorded by 267 crowd-sourced workers acting out prescribed composite activity scripts in their own homes. Totaling 82 hours of video, it contains 66,500 annotated temporal activity intervals covering 157 multi-label action classes and 46 object classes interacting across 15 indoor locations. It supports both multi-label action classification and fine-grained temporal action localization.
